name: Cognitive Maze v2.5.3 - Alt+Tab Crash Prevention, Cloud Sync Accuracy & Developer Cheats
notes: Version 2.5.3: Resolves Alt+Tab crashes via borderless fullscreen display mode and exception boundaries; eliminates CPU burn when minimized via idle throttling; resets stuck key modifiers and gesture states on focus transitions; enforces strict web-app cloud question synchronization (locking empty assessment slots instead of falling back to Assessment 1, fixing unit title matching, and syncing Remedial lookups); adds F1-F8/Ctrl+S Developer Cheats HUD; separates fractional answered items from 100-point scaled score in Assessment Selection modal; auto-enters portals upon final puzzle completion; maintains 60 FPS on AMD A4-6300 hardware.
